assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamlessly tileable wall albedo texture.
Primary request: warm cream lime plaster as seen between the timbers in the concept art. Smooth trowelled surface with very gentle tonal variation, a few faint hairline cracks and soft warm stains. No timber, no bricks, no edges.
Palette: warm cream and pale ivory with subtle ochre variation; bright overall.
Composition: orthographic straight-on flat surface filling the whole 1024x1024 square edge to edge. The pattern must continue seamlessly across both image edges so the image tiles.
Style: stylised hand-painted game texture, broad readable shapes, soft painterly brushwork, low noise, no photographic grain.
Lighting: uniform diffuse albedo, no directional shadows, no specular highlights, no ambient occlusion gradients.
Avoid: scene, perspective, objects, text, borders, vignette, framing, symbols. One opaque RGB tile.

assets.processing: Cropped to 6 tile rows x 7 tile columns (x 234, y 178, 975 x 942 px) so the pattern repeats, then resized to 1024. One narrow tile column remains at the vertical seam. Colour shifted toward orange (R x0.72, G x0.88, B x0.50) and contrast about the mean raised x1.35: the game tone-maps with AgX under a sun of intensity 10, which turned the generated pure red salmon pink at noon.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: albedo texture of a single wooden door leaf, to be mapped onto a flat rectangular door panel.
Primary request: a medieval plank door seen straight on, filling the entire image from edge to edge with no wall, frame or background visible. Palette: warm medium-dark chestnut brown planks, clearly lighter than near-black timber beams but darker than cream plaster; dark grey iron.
